summary: Iteration 10 verification of ParlourPilot UI changes (multi-tenant SaaS). Ran targeted pytest suite (17 tests) covering all 6 tasks against the live public URL and did a Playwright mobile smoke test (390x844). Result: 16/17 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: Members chips (All/Active/Expiring/Expired) with counts render + filter works (screenshot iter10_04/05), Manage entries present (Branches, Salon Settings, Users), Branches screen shows 2 branches with logo placeholder + subscription pricing (iter10_06). One critical bug found: PUT /api/auth/users/{uid} with body {branch_id: null} does NOT clear the branch — server code at server.py:921 uses `if body.branch_id is not None`, which silently drops the null and leaves the previous value. This directly breaks the Users screen 'All Branches (Owner)' toggle described in task 6 for existing users being edited. Assigning a specific branch works (register + update). Everything else (member 20% override -> bill.member_discount_pct_applied=20, branch logo PUT, branch invoice_prefix/tax/receipt_footer PUT preserves head branch, tenant PUT with website/discount/min-price) passed.

critical.issue: Sending {branch_id: null} does NOT clear branch_id — server keeps the previous value. Root cause: server.py:921 `if body.branch_id is not None: ... updates['branch_id'] = body.branch_id or None` never fires when the client sends null. Impact: admin cannot be switched to 'All Branches (Owner)' via the Users edit modal — the branch chip UI toggles visually but the persisted value stays unchanged. Fix: switch the guard to `if 'branch_id' in body.model_fields_set:` (Pydantic v2) or accept model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so nulls flow through.

rca_of_issue:
BUG: 'All Branches (Owner)' toggle no-op on edit.
Reproduction: 1) Login admin@glowup.com. 2) Manage → Users → edit any user with branch_id set. 3) Toggle 'All Branches (Owner)' (branch_id becomes null). 4) Save → API PUT /auth/users/{id} body includes branch_id:null. 5) Reload list → row still shows old branch.
Root cause: server.py update_user() line 921 `if body.branch_id is not None: ...` — because Pydantic parses JSON null as Python None, the whole branch update block is skipped and updates dict has no branch_id key, so $set doesn't touch the field.
Mitigation (recommended patch):
```python
fields_set = body.model_fields_set  # Pydantic v2
if 'branch_id' in fields_set:
    if body.branch_id:
        br = await db.branches.find_one({'id': body.branch_id, 'tenant_id': tid})
        if not br: raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid branch')
    updates['branch_id'] = body.branch_id  # None allowed
```
Applies analogously to any other Optional field where 'clear to null' is a legitimate operation.
